title: selaginella rupestris var. rupincola
intro: Selaginella rupestris var. rupincola, commonly known as Rock Spikemoss, is a species of plant in the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Rock Spikemoss include its ability to soothe the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and support the immune system. Bioactive constituents of Rock Spikemoss include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
